Namespace: [Ankus](/api/ankus/)

Controls whether PostgreSQL invokes a generated function when arguments are SQL NULL.

```csharp
public enum PgNullInput
```

## Fields

<a id="member-d16972b275ec312a"></a>

### CalledOnNull

Invokes managed code with NULL arguments. Every SQL parameter must have a nullable declaration.

```csharp
CalledOnNull = 2
```

<a id="member-89eff3426d4f41be"></a>

### Inferred

Declares STRICT when all SQL parameters are required; mixed signatures still reject NULL required arguments before dispatch.

```csharp
Inferred = 0
```

<a id="member-b1a5b309fdacc89d"></a>

### Strict

Returns SQL NULL without calling managed code whenever any argument is NULL.

```csharp
Strict = 1
```
